name: appwrite
description: A backend platform providing authentication, databases, storage, and realtime APIs
atGlance: A backend platform providing authentication, databases, storage, and realtime APIs
fullDescription: Appwrite is a secure, open-source backend server that provides auth, file storage, databases, functions, and realtime APIs.

additionalFeatures.name: API Access
additionalFeatures.description: Access services via SDKs and APIs

deployCompose:
version: "3.9"

x-logging: &x-logging
  logging:
    driver: json-file
    options:
      max-size: "10m"
      max-file: "5"

services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:2.11
    container_name: appwrite-traefik
    <<: *x-logging
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - --log.level=INFO
      - --providers.docker=true
